reasons.text: Energy charges do not match units x tariff on 100% of bills (worst bill charged 61% of expected)
Certificates claim more than the declared monthly capacity in 62% of months
100% of certificate tonnes were sold below the cost of recycling (average 0.38x the cost floor)
Certificates sold at 0.43x the market median price
Category III share of certificates is 30%, +28% versus what its process route can produce
Registered at an address shared with 1 other entity(ies)

inspection_checklist: Verify the electricity bills directly with the DISCOM (units, tariff, amount); the uploaded copies do not reconcile.
Check installed machinery and shift records against the declared capacity; request production registers for the flagged months.
Ask for the plant's cost sheet; certificates priced below the cost of recycling imply the processing cost was never incurred.
Cross-check the certificate generation dates and category mix against the plant's process route and stock registers.
Compare the plant against the entities sharing its identifiers (bank, address, director, photos); consider a joint inspection.
